platform.target: Game Boy Advance ROM (ARM7TDMI, Thumb code, built with arm-none-eabi gcc); runs in mGBA 0.10; not yet tried on hardware
platform.display_mode: mode 0, four tiled backgrounds, 4bpp (16-index banks, index 0 transparent), OBJ 1D mapping

bg_layers.BG0: text, HUD, dialogue: priority 0, charblock 2, screenblock 23, 32x32 tiles
bg_layers.BG1: room overlay (tree crowns, sparkles, mist, the mystery rooms' pots, plates, chests, spring): priority 1, charblock 0, screenblock 24, 64x64 tiles
bg_layers.BG2: room ground: priority 2, charblock 0, screenblock 28, 64x64 tiles
bg_layers.BG3: the pause menu's plank backdrop: priority 3, charblock 3, screenblock 22

platform.sprites: OBJ priority 2 (above the ground, under the overlay); some effects priority 1 (above the overlay). OBJ VRAM 1024 4bpp tiles: sheets and frames are streamed in per room, the last 16 tiles hold the mini-map. Sprite palettes are separate from BG palettes.
platform.blending: none in rooms (BLDCNT 0); fades use brightness only
platform.colour: BGR555: each channel 5 bits; an 8-bit value v is stored as v >> 3, and read back as (c << 3) | (c >> 2)

tiles.metatile: 16x16 logical cell = four 8x8 hardware pieces, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
tiles.palette_per_metatile: one bank for all four pieces of a metatile (the importer assigns one group per metatile; per-piece banks would be a small importer change)
tiles.dedupe: identical 8x8 pieces are stored once, also when one is the other flipped horizontally, vertically or both; animated metatiles are not deduped
tiles.animation: a metatile with N frames swaps all its four pieces every D/60 s (frame = (frame counter // D) % N); every copy in a room animates in step
tiles.overlay: index 0 is transparent on BG1; ground tiles on BG2 must be opaque (index 0 shows the backdrop colour)
tiles.collision: per 8x8 quarter of a metatile; types decide what a solid quarter does (wall, water, pit, thorn, lift...)

rooms.forest: generated, 32x24 metatiles (512x384 px), the camera scrolls; 25 rooms a run from a seed

importer.module: art/env_pack.py, run last in the art pipeline, in both builds
importer.reads: art/ref/pack_v3/manifest.json and art/ref/pack_v3/assets/<group>/<key>.png, keys of tile spec v1
checks: every v1 key has exactly one asset and no asset is unknown (the build fails otherwise)
size = columns x 16 by rows x 16 x frames
every opaque pixel is exactly one of its group's 15 colours; no partial alpha
ground tiles fully opaque; transparency only in overlay entries and tree crown rows
one 16-colour palette per group across all its files
